title: Public Website Administration
subtitle: Visual modular page editor, admission form builder, and menu styles.
pages_structure_desc: Click "Edit Modules" to customize the blocks of each page.
settings_desc: Choose how the portal header and navigation look.
help_what: This page allows you to manage the node's public website. You can edit pages, customize the menu and header, and configure the admission form.
help_pages: In the "Site Pages" tab you can see all public pages. Click "Edit Modules" to customize each page's content with a visual modular editor.
help_styles: In "Menu Styles & Settings" you can choose the visual style of the header, configure colors, logo, and footer texts.
help_admission: In "Admission & Dynamic Form" you can view received applications and design the fields that applicants will fill in. You can also elevate applications to the assembly for voting.
no_modules_yet: This page has no modules yet.
select_module_to_edit: Select a module to edit it
select_module_hint: Click any module in the left list to modify its titles, images, cards and texts in real time.
footer_desc: Edit the texts that appear in the public site footer.
admission_requests_desc: Evaluate applicant responses before elevating to assembly.
rejection_reason_min: The reason must be at least 10 characters long
form_builder_desc: Freely design the fields that applicants will fill in at /p/unirse.
restore_confirm: Restore to the default agroecological form?
select_component: Select from the available visual components.
template_confirm: Do you want to apply the complete template with all modules and pre-designed photos? This will update existing public pages with the enriched design.
template_applied: Live modular template successfully applied to all pages!
settings_saved: Site settings and menu style saved successfully!
link_picker_internal_desc: Link to a page within the node.
link_picker_external_desc: Link to another website (opens in a new tab).
link_picker_anchor_desc: Jump to a specific section within a page (e.g: #contact).
tc_drag_hint: Drag to move · See live changes
tc_logo_hint: The same logo appears in header and footer.
tc_sticky: Sticky menu (pinned to top on scroll)
tc_colors_empty_hint: Leave empty to use the general palette colors.
tc_default_image_hint: Leave empty to use default image
tc_carousel_hint: Paste several URLs separated by commas for an automatic carousel.
tc_menu_lang_hint: (Titles are saved in the selected language on save)
tc_flat_menu_hint: Reorder menu pages in a flat list. Changes are visible live in the header.
tc_hierarchical_hint: Drag pages into others to create submenus. Top-level pages appear in the header; children expand on hover. Ideal for the Mega Menu style.
tc_colors_hint: Each palette defines 8 colors: primary, secondary, text, button hover, module background, page background, footer background, and link color. Changes are visible live.
tc_footer_hint: Edit the footer texts. Changes are visible live below.
tc_pages_from_menu: Pages are reordered from the "Menu" tab.
admission_field_full_name_ph: E.g: Maria Rodriguez / Agroecological Collective El Conuco
admission_field_full_name_help: Enter your full name or the name of your collective/productive unit.
admission_field_username_help: This is how you want to be identified on the network. Only letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores. No spaces.
admission_field_password_help: With this password you can log in to check the status of your application.
admission_field_password_confirm_help: Verify that you typed your password correctly.
admission_field_email_help: We will send you confirmation and assembly announcements.
admission_field_phone_help: Main channel to coordinate training visits or direct contact.
admission_field_participation_type_help: Select how you want to participate in the community.
admission_field_location: Location / Area where you live or produce
admission_field_location_ph: E.g: El Junquito Km 18 / La Pastora / Valles del Tuy / Baruta
admission_field_skills: What goods, products or knowledge do you want to contribute to the community?
admission_field_skills_ph: E.g: Leafy greens, native corn seeds, gluten-free baking, propolis tinctures, vermicompost workshops...
admission_field_skills_help: Detail what you produce or the knowledge you can share at the fair workshops.
admission_field_agro_practices: What agroecological practices do you implement in your production?
admission_field_agro_practices_help: Check all that apply to your work.
admission_field_reason: Why do you want to join the barter and solidarity economy network?
admission_field_reason_ph: Tell us your motivation to participate in food sovereignty and solidarity exchange...
admission_field_reason_help: This answer will be evaluated by the producers' assembly.
admission_field_how_heard: How did you hear about us?
admission_field_how_heard_help: To understand how our popular network grows.
admission_opt_pesticide_free: 100% free of agrotoxins, pesticides and chemical poisons
admission_opt_compost: Composting, biol and own organic fertilizers
admission_opt_native_seeds: Use and custody of native creole seeds free of GMOs
admission_opt_polyculture: Biodiverse polyculture and respect for land cycles
admission_opt_water_care: Water source care and biomass recycling
admission_opt_eco_packaging: Eco-friendly packaging and plastic bag reduction
header_style_modern_eco_desc: Logo on left with icons on each button, horizontal menu, primary color background.
header_style_fao_institutional_desc: Two rows: logo on top, card-style menu with icons and border below. Each item is a visual card.
header_style_editorial_latam_desc: Two rows: brand on top in white, dark bar with uppercase menu below.
header_style_agrodigital_mincyt_desc: Header with energy rate badge (1 TQ = 1 kWh) and tech-style buttons.
header_style_dropdown_categories_desc: Menu grouped by categories with dropdowns: About the Network, Economy, Community.
header_style_compact_desc: Large centered logo with title below, horizontal menu in colored bar underneath.
header_style_banner_desc: Background image with dark overlay, superimposed logo, translucent menu at bottom.
header_style_sidebar_left_desc: Fixed vertical menu on left, content on right. Dashboard style.
header_style_split_center_desc: Centered logo, menu split to left and right of logo, CTA at the end.
header_style_minimal_underline_desc: No background, text only with underline animation on hover. Maximum minimalism.
header_style_hero_overlay_desc: Transparent menu overlaid on hero image, becomes solid on scroll.
header_style_sticky_pill_desc: Floating centered menu in rounded pill shape with shadow. Modern SaaS style.
